steps.title: Why Migrate to Surgewave?
steps.text: Surgewave eliminates the JVM dependency, ZooKeeper complexity, and operational overhead of Kafka while providing first-class .NET support and a single-binary deployment.

steps.title: Protocol Compatibility
steps.text: Surgewave speaks the Kafka protocol natively. Point your existing Kafka clients at a Surgewave broker by simply changing the bootstrap servers address.

steps.title: API Wrapper Migration
steps.text: Replace the Confluent.Kafka NuGet package with Surgewave's compatible wrapper. Your existing code stays the same while running on Surgewave's high-performance engine.

steps.title: Native Surgewave Client
steps.text: For best performance, rewrite to use the native Surgewave client API. This gives you access to Surgewave-specific features and optimized throughput.

steps.title: Migration Path
steps.text: Follow a phased approach: test compatibility first, then run a hybrid deployment alongside Kafka, and finally perform a full cutover when ready.
